explanation: King of Judea who ruled during the time of the prophet Isaiah and was known for his cruelty and tyranny.
A future day when God will judge all people, both living and dead, and reward or punish them according to their deeds.
An ancient kingdom southeast of Israel, often described as an enemy of the Israelites. In Isaiah 34, Edom represents God's judgment against all nations that oppose his people.
A symbol of God's judgment and punishment, used to describe how he will destroy the wicked and protect the righteous.
A ritual act in which animals or other objects are offered to God as a form of worship and gratitude. In Isaiah 34, sacrifice is a symbol of God's judgment and punishment upon the wicked.
The upper part of the universe, regarded as God's dwelling place and the location where angels and holy people reside after death.
The planet we live on, created by God and given to humanity as their home and responsibility.
The vital force that enables organisms to grow, reproduce, and sustain themselves. God is the source of all life.
